prose_updates.tldr: Fixed geographic cells reveal integrals of latent response surfaces, not their boundary traces. Under maintained known polygonal score laws, bounded outcomes, and separately calibrated arm-specific isotropic Lipschitz restrictions, the weighted boundary effect has an attained sharp interval whose support values equal clipping-aware partial-transport costs inside an unrestricted exact-moment multiplier dual. Closed-form rectangle, nonuniform-density, and weighted-triangle laws expose when fixed resolution is vacuous, informative, or sign identifying. Deterministically projected atomic outer programs converge with an explicit correction, exact-moment piecewise-affine inner programs converge on the relative interior with quantitative gaps, and simultaneous bounded-mean box inversion covers the whole identified interval in finite samples. For rational polygonal relative-interior instances, a terminating exact-arithmetic primal-reconstruction and dual-enclosure routine returns arbitrarily tight certified endpoint intervals, and the application reports a prespecified score-law and radius sensitivity frontier.

project_justification.fill: The project characterizes the exact causal set and its transport dual, proves the multiplier-attainment frontier and analytic planar formulas, derives deterministic inner and outer programs with whole-set inference, proves terminating exact-arithmetic primal reconstruction and outward dual enclosure for rational relative-interior instances, and requires a prespecified application sensitivity frontier for maintained score laws and separate arm-specific radii.

prose_updates.honest_scope: The population identification, transport representation, planar formulas, relative-interior approximation bounds, confidence-box coverage, and terminating verified reconstruction are proved theorem results. The reconstruction guarantee applies to compact convex rational polygonal supports with rational polygonal cells and boundary, rational piecewise-constant cell densities, rational nonnegative normalized piecewise-affine boundary weights, rational inputs, and a relative-interior compatible moment vector; it verifies exact continuous moments and returns shrinking rational outward endpoint enclosures without asserting a bit-complexity bound. Known within-cell score laws and separately selected arm-specific smoothness radii are maintained nonstandard inputs, not facts established by Qiu and Stoye or for Dell's data; the application protocol therefore reports the full prespecified sensitivity frontier and certifies a sign only when it is invariant across that grid. The sharpness claim conditions only on cell means, not on full within-cell outcome distributions. No universal boundary-face inner recovery, universal finite multipliers, floating-residual certificate, shrinking-cell asymptotic, or empirical reanalysis is claimed. When \(M_d=0\), the model reduces to constant compatible surfaces; the displayed rectangle cases recover both the vacuous interval and a strict sign interval as required sanity checks.
